messages:
oncall-bot: INCIDENT P1 — elevated 5xx + fallback cascade detected for /v1/generate (us-west-2). Initial spike: 14:02Z. Pager routed to emma :pager:

emma: acknowledged. i'm on it. first pass: are we seeing a model variant mismatch or infra flake?

raj: i'm looking at the routing decisions — looks like smart-routing selected an experimental quantized variant 'rw-serve-lm:v2-quant' for a subset of requests. that variant failed the streaming handshake and returned 502s, then our fallback policy routed traffic to alternate regions/variants. clients retried and we ended up with a feedback amplification (thundering herd).

emma: can you paste the routing logs?

raj: logs (excerpt):
```
[2026-03-15T14:02:12Z] route_decision session=sess-9a4 select_variant=rw-serve-lm:v2-quant reason=cost_heuristic
[2026-03-15T14:02:12Z] healthcheck variant=rw-serve-lm:v2-quant status=unhealthy error=streaming_not_supported
[2026-03-15T14:02:12Z] proxy_err code=502 target=rw-serve-lm:v2-quant details=decode_fail
[2026-03-15T14:02:12Z] client_retry api_key=key-xxxx count=2 backoff_ms=200
[2026-03-15T14:02:13Z] fallback_routed region=us-east-1 count=1340
[2026-03-15T14:02:13Z] region_load us-east-1 rps=2300 us-west-2 rps=1900
```

emma: ok that matches the pager graph — big spike in cross-region failover. i'm going to: 1) disable automatic fallback policy temporarily 2) throttle routing decisions for that model 3) ask platform to spin up compatible variant in us-west-2.

sarah: confirmed policy 'smart-fallback-v1' has an overly broad compatible_variants list that includes the v2-quant image. that quant build lacks streaming protocol support. i'm going to patch the policy to exclude '*-quant' variants immediately.

emma: mitigation commands i'm about to run (running now):
```
# disable automatic fallback
curl -s -X POST "https://control-plane.internal/api/policies/smart-fallback-v1/disable" -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN"

# set route throttle for model to 500 rps
curl -s -X POST "https://control-plane.internal/api/routes/override" -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN" -d '{"model":"rw-serve-lm:v2","max_rps":500}'
```

deploy-bot: policy change deployed: smart-fallback-v1 -> DISABLED (deploy id dpl-20260315-9a7) :white_check_mark:

liam: i'm bringing up 6 warm replicas of the non-quant variant in us-west-2, should be ready in ~8m. applying conservative scaling to avoid extra autoscale thrash.

raj: also recommending we patch client-side guidance for exponential backoff — some clients were retrying aggressively with minimal jitter which multiplied the failover load. can we set temporary token-level rate limits for the top offending API keys?

emma: yes, please list top keys. mike / julie-cs, can you triage customers and notify them?

mike: on it. top affected accounts: acct-omega, acct-zen, acct-emit. sending targeted incident notice now. draft note: "We're investigating higher error rates and intermittent failures for model rw-serve-lm. We're applying mitigations; you may see retries/latency while we stabilize. We'll follow up with a root cause and remediation timeline."

julie-cs: sent notifications to account owners + CS triage. flagged acct-omega as high-severity (SLA impacted).

emma: performing temporary token-level throttles on the most aggressive keys. command:
```
# throttle key-abc -> 50 rps
curl -X POST "https://control-plane.internal/api/keys/key-abc/throttle" -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN" -d '{"rps":50}'
```

raj: noticed client_retry header patterns: some SDKs were setting max_retries=5 with constant backoff=100ms. that needs a quick SDK patch to recommend jittered exponential backoff. i'll open a PR and publish an interim advisory.

emma: handing off incident to raj for follow-through on routing policy fix and SDK advisory. oncall handoff: emma -> raj at 14:20Z.

raj: taking lead. immediate next steps: 1) prune compatible_variants in smart-fallback-v1 (done) 2) add strict healthcheck gating for fallback 3) create temporary fail-open circuit-breaker to avoid region cascades.

sarah: pushed policy patch: removed '*-quant' patterns, added gating: "only fallback to variant if health.passes > 3 consecutive checks". change id: cfg-334b. deployed at 14:28Z.

liam: replicas up and healthy in us-west-2. synthetic checks passing.

deploy-bot: config cfg-334b deployed (rollout 100%) :rocket:

raj: monitoring traffic now. seeing request rate settle back to baseline ~5m after changes. fallback events reduced >95%. still seeing a small uptick in 5xx from a subset of clients — likely cached retry storms.

emma: summary for page handoff: root cause = policy/config mismatch allowed incompatible quantized variant in fallback set + aggressive client retries amplified cross-region fallback leading to thundering herd. mitigation = disabled fallback, pruned policy, spun up compatible replicas, token-level throttles, SDK advisory. impact = elevated 5xx and latency for multiple customers (top 3 notified).

mike: support note: sent follow-up to affected accounts with mitigation steps and ETA for RCA.

raj: post-incident actions and owners:
- raj: implement policy test that validates variant compatibility matrix before adding to fallback lists
- liam: improve autoscale cold-start smoothing for region failover (workload-based warmups)
- emma: add an automated circuit-breaker in routing to detect retry amplification and stop cross-region failovers
- eng-devex (raj): publish SDK advisory + patch doc for backoff recommendations
- cs (julie-cs): run a customer-impact review and collect sample request ids for legal/SLA follow-up

emma: assigning owners in tracker. will schedule a postmortem sync in 48h.

raj: thanks all — leaving monitoring on for the next 2h. ping me for urgent regressions. :thumbsup:

oncall-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigations applied, error rate reduced to baseline, incident state -> monitoring. closed page at 14:50Z.
